title: The Aperiodic Jordan Algebras of Quasicrystals Are Not Jordan
description: LaTeX source and verification code for the paper proving that the aperiodic Jordan algebras of Fibonacci-chain and icosahedral quasicrystals defined by quasiaddition are not Jordan algebras: they are not even power-associative, x^2x^2 = x^3x holding exactly for multiples of a basis element. Finite truncations are not Jordan, the proposed ideal is not an ideal, and the algebra has no unit and embeds in no Jordan algebra.
